approved.en: Russia continues airstrikes on Ukrainian energy facilities, with recent attacks on multiple power plants and Zaporizhzhia killing 17, while Ukraine says it will pause refinery strikes if Russia ends its energy attacks. President Trump announced an alleged Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire linked to a diesel deal and urged a change in Ukrainian leadership, and Zelenskyy called the ceasefire claim increasingly false after further strikes. The Houthi movement launched a second missile strike on Riyadh airport, killing a Pakistani national and wounding several people, prompting Saudi Arabia to extend airport suspensions. 75,767 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israel has approved a US firm to identify sites for handing over Hamas arms and is working with the Board of Peace on demilitarisation, while Defence Minister Herzog says a larger police force is needed to curb violent crime and settler attacks. Israeli intelligence soldiers disclosed a policy shift that justifies civilian casualties in Gaza, and Israel downgraded the UK consulate in Jerusalem over a West Bank trade ban. The conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
